items.title: Betye Saar, Picasso, BlackStar
items.summary: The little-known story of a stolen Picasso that once belonged to the Guggenheim Museum, Zeitz MOCAA’s new leader, and the discovery of a 2,000-year-old Roman shipwreck.

items.title: Shirley Tse and Dana Berman Duff's Breathing Moons
items.summary: The artist duo — who go by "Relational" — explore the unseen forces that bind us to the universe.

items.title: New Digital Archive Honors Gaza Journalists Killed by Israel
items.summary: The project developed by the Writers Against the War on Gaza serves as a digital memorial for the around 240 Palestinian journalists killed in Gaza since October 2023.

items.title: The Artist Mapping Knoxville’s Art Scene With Wood and Wire
items.summary: Three years ago, Lauren Farkas sketched a plan to see exhibitions during the city’s monthly art walk. Now, she crafts eclectic maps for each event to make the art scene more accessible.
